title: Redis cache down
symptoms: Error connecting to Redis on cache-01:6379. Connection refused. Cache hit rate drops to zero and database load jumps.
root_cause: The Redis process crashed or was OOM killed, or its host or network is down.
impact: Every request goes to the database, so it is slower and the database may overload.
fix_steps: Check the Redis process and its log; restart it.
Check maxmemory and the eviction policy if it was OOM killed.
Watch database load while the cache warms up again.
prevention: Run Redis with a replica and Sentinel, set maxmemory with an eviction policy, and make apps tolerate cache misses.
